description:
The latest SEC 8-K filings of one company, newest first: when each was filed, what
it reports and, on Pro, what it says. 8-Ks are how a US-listed company announces results,
deals, financings, leadership changes and other material events.

Free returns the 5 most recent filings (`items_note` says so when more exist); Pro up
to 25. Per filing, for every account:
- filed_at (ISO 8601 with the New York offset), date, time (New York time) and session (before open / during
  trading / after close)
- items: what the filing covers, as plain labels (for example "Results of operations",
  "Director or officer change", "Material agreement")
- company, symbol and the SEC accession number

Pro adds `headline` (one line on what it says), `summary` (two or three sentences),
`sentiment` (Positive/Negative/Neutral, the tone of the news for the company, not a
price call) and `relevance` (0-100, how material the filing looks; routine filings are
left out for everyone). A filing with no usable text has no summary.

Coverage: US-listed companies in USD with a market cap of about $1 billion or more.
Filings are recorded in the morning, before the US open and after the close, so one
filed minutes ago may not be there yet. For the filing together
with news, insider and analyst activity in one timeline, use get_stock_activity.
For informational purposes only. Not financial advice.

limit.description: Max filings returned (default 10, max 25; Free returns up to 5). The whole call counts as one call toward your daily limit.

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol. Also accepts a company name as a fallback when it uniquely resolves to one symbol.
